summary:
Wrote src\en\module_01
-concepts-c.md: Sections s9 (1,430 words / target 1,300), s10 (1,687 / 1,500), s11 (1,724 / 1,800), s12 (1,265 / 1,300), all within +/-15%, plus '## What goes wrong {#wrong}' (15 items as ### symptom with Cause and Fix, about 930 words). The file is about 7,040 words in all. Every must-cover item, worked example, figure (fig-01-18 to fig-01-27) and check in the slice is placed. I recomputed every number with labpy.sh: the s9 shrinkage, ridge/lasso, MAP and Lab 3 ridge path (CV picks lambda=0.032 and so does the 1-SE rule; test 0.324/0.348/0.684); the s10 standard errors, E[max of 200 normals]=2.746, Lab 4's three leaks, the bootstrap intervals and McNemar p-values; the s11 curse-of-dimensionality, Gini, forest variance, PCA and make_moons CV accuracies (random_state=0, shuffled StratifiedKFold); and the s12 hand fit and all the Lab 5 neo-Hookean and Gent numbers. The checker reports no errors in my file.
changes: s12 / generalised_refs loading-direction numbers: the percentages are relative to the correctly read fit over the same strain range, not to the true c1 = 10 kPa. Over 0-20%, 12.97 kPa is 28.5% above the correct reading's 10.09 kPa (29.7% above the true value). Over the first 5%, the misread fit gives 10.60 kPa against the correct reading's 9.75 kPa (8.7% high; 6.0% above the true value). The text states the reference explicitly.

s12 residuals: with the neo-Hookean fit to all 16 points, the positive-then-negative residual run (P - P_hat > 0 with negative stresses) means the model is too stiff at small strains and too soft at large ones. The text says this; the plan states no direction.

Added measured details that are not in the plan: the effective degrees of freedom at the CV-chosen lambda = 0.032 is 10.4 of 16 (constant unpenalised); the recall standard error for Lab 2 (51/53, SE 0.026, with only two misses, too few for the normal approximation); the Laplace-prior MAP strength lambda = 2 sigma^2/(N b).
Two notation choices: early stopping writes the eigenvalues of H as h_i in s9 to avoid a clash with the regularisation lambda; the RBF feature-map index is j, because k is the kernel.
issues: The checker reports one ERROR, in another writer's file: 11-concepts-b.md:993, a KaTeX parse failure near '$\E_{\mathcal{D}}[\hat f] =  ar f'. The same file's polynomial-capacity widget body (about line 1095) also has a stray backtick in '$N = 200`', which probably unbalances the dollar pairing.
The plan's session 5 links to #what_goes_wrong, but SPEC fixes the id as {#wrong}, which I used. The study plan or build should map it.
The AI Agents evaluation module's number is not known, so s10 links to ../agent/index.html rather than to a specific module page.

The Lab 5 Monte Carlo SD for the 20% neo-Hookean fit (0.0995) is the plan's figure. The formula value (0.0997) and the Gent Monte Carlo SDs (0.099/0.025) I confirmed independently with a different seed.
